summary: First end-to-end test of Trailscribe. Backend: 19/19 pytest tests passed (health, discovery for bengaluru/delhi + 404/422 edge cases, POST /api/routes/generate with claude and gemini incl. geometry/elevation/narration/llm_guess/failure_log assertions, Delhi generation, save + saved-list persistence, validation). Frontend: home page, sidebar, all form testids, mapbox render, discovery tabs/cards, city switch, discovery-card pick, first route generation (claude on Delhi + gemini on Bengaluru), narration panel, elevation profile, failure log with LLM-vs-map line, and SAVE (200 + success toast) all work. ONE CRITICAL frontend bug: generating a SECOND route crashes the app with an uncaught Mapbox error (whitescreen / runtime-error overlay) due to a layer-id mismatch in RouteMap.jsx cleanup.

minor.issue: ORS round_trip overshoots the requested distance substantially: 5km request -> 6.62km actual, 7km request -> 9.03km actual (~29% over). Within the agreed 2.5-8km tolerance for a 5km ask, but the UI shows the requested value on the slider while the map/narration show a much larger route with no note that ORS could not honour the target.
FastAPI @app.on_event("shutdown") is deprecated; migrate to lifespan handlers.
avoid_highways constraint is a documented no-op for the foot-walking profile (pass block). Constraint is accepted from the client but never affects geometry - only narration.

ui_bugs.issue: CRITICAL: second (and every subsequent) route generation crashes the whole app. clearLayer() is called for ids 'route-line' and 'route-glow', but the layers actually created are 'route-glow' and 'route-line-top'. removeSource('route-line') therefore throws "Source 'route-line' cannot be removed while layer 'route-line-top' is using it", the effect aborts, and the next addSource throws the uncaught "There is already a source with ID 'route-line'" -> React error overlay / blank screen. Narration panel never appears on the 2nd generate. Fix: clear 'route-line-top' (and 'route-glow') layers before removing the 'route-line' source, wrap in try/catch, e.g. ['route-glow','route-line-top'].forEach(id => map.getLayer(id) && map.removeLayer(id)); then removeSource('route-line').

integration_issues.issue: POST /api/routes/generate succeeds but the UI cannot render the new route; app throws an uncaught runtime error and the user must reload the page. Every other flow (first generate, save, discovery) is fine.

issues: Failure log panel is clipped at the viewport bottom on a 1080p screen; SAVE / COPY GPS buttons require scrolling the sidebar and are not discoverable after a route is generated.
Narration panel (max-h-70vh) clips the segments list; scroll is silent with no-scrollbar so there is no affordance indicating more content.

action_items: CRITICAL: fix RouteMap.jsx layer cleanup ('route-line-top' is never removed) so repeat generations work instead of whitescreening the app.
Consider surfacing an info/warn failure_log entry when the ORS actual distance deviates >20% from the requested distance, so the slider value vs the real route is explained.
Optional: make SAVE / COPY GPS sticky in the sidebar so they are visible without scrolling; add a scroll affordance to the narration panel.
critical_code_review_comments: RouteMap.jsx: layer ids used at creation ('route-glow', 'route-line-top') do not match ids passed to clearLayer ('route-line', 'route-glow'); wrap all map.removeLayer/removeSource calls in try/catch since Mapbox throws synchronously inside a React effect.
route_service.generate_loop_route: no retry when ORS returns a route far from the requested length; a single seed can overshoot by ~30%.
server.py generate(): two sequential LLM calls with no timeout guard - a slow provider will hold the request for the full client 90s timeout.
seed_data_creation: One saved route named 'TEST_Saved Route' plus routes saved via the UI SAVE button are in the saved_routes collection.
test_credentials: None - /app/memory/test_credentials.md documents that no auth exists in this MVP; all endpoints public.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend regression suite lives at /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py (19 tests, session-scoped generate fixtures; run takes ~80s; use timeout>=150s for /api/routes/generate). Frontend flows verified: load, all builder testids, mapbox render, discovery both cities, card pick, first generate (claude+gemini), narration/elevation/failure-log, SAVE. NOT verifiable until the RouteMap fix lands: repeat generation, route redraw after city switch. Retest by generating twice in a row and asserting no console error containing 'already a source with ID'.
rca_of_the_issue: RouteMap.jsx draw effect creates layers 'route-glow' and 'route-line-top' on source 'route-line', but the cleanup helper is invoked with ids 'route-line' and 'route-glow'. On re-render, map.removeSource('route-line') throws because 'route-line-top' still references it; the exception escapes the useEffect, so markers/layers are left in place and the subsequent map.addSource('route-line') throws 'There is already a source with ID route-line', producing an uncaught React runtime error and a blank app. Reproduce: load app -> GENERATE ROUTE -> wait for narration -> GENERATE ROUTE again.
